Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: A group trip expense ledger owned by a creator with optional co-host editors, INR budget tracking, and read-only synced members.

creatorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the primary trip creator.

creatorName.description: Display name of the primary trip creator.

title.description: Trip name shown across the ledger and archival PDF.

currencyCode.description: 3-letter ISO currency code for the trip (defaults to INR).

budgetCents.description: Optional trip budget in minor units (paise for INR). 0 means no budget set.

status.description: Lifecycle state; once ended, the trip, bills, and settlements become immutable.

joinCode.description: Secret invite token embedded in the trip QR code.

lastJoinCodeAttempt.description: Last verified join code submitted when a viewer joined via QR.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of authenticated UIDs allowed to read the trip ledger.

coHostUids.description: Bounded list of signed-in member UIDs granted co-host edit permissions on bills and settlements.

members.description: Bounded list of trip participant records ({memberId, displayName, linkedUid}).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

endedAt.description: Optional server timestamp set when the creator ends and archives the trip.

Bill.title: Bill
Bill.description: An itemized trip expense with location details, payer, subset participants, and equal/percentage/exact splits.

creatorUid.description: UID of the creator or co-host who authored the bill.

amountCents.description: Total bill amount in integer minor units (paise).

paidByMemberId.description: Primary member ID of the person who paid the bill.

payers.description: Optional list of multi-payer split payment entries ({memberId, amountCents, paymentMethod}) for Cash + UPI / Card / Points.

splitMode.description: Whether the bill is split equally, by custom exact amounts, or by custom percentages.

participantIds.description: Subset of trip member IDs participating in this bill split.

splits.description: Map of memberId to exact owed amount in integer minor units.

splitPercentages.description: Optional map of memberId to basis points (0..10000 where 5000 = 50.00%) when splitMode is percentage.

receiptAttached.description: Whether a receipt photo exists in the receipts subcollection.

billDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the expense date/time.

deleted.description: Soft-delete flag placing the bill in the Creator/Co-Host recovery Trash Bin until restored or permanently purged.

deletedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the bill was soft-deleted (0 when active).

deletedByUid.description: UID of the creator or co-host who soft-deleted the bill.

BillReceipt.title: BillReceipt
BillReceipt.description: Compressed JPEG receipt image synced separately from lightweight bill records.

SettlementRecord.title: SettlementRecord
SettlementRecord.description: A recorded payment between two trip members that deducts from simplified balances.

SyncedTripUser.title: SyncedTripUser
SyncedTripUser.description: Signed-in participant directory entry for a trip so the creator can manage co-hosts and transfer ownership.

User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated Billi user profile isolated strictly to the owning account.

UserTripLink.title: UserTripLink
UserTripLink.description: Maps a signed-in user to their chosen participant memberId within a trip for personal balance summaries.

/trips/{tripId}.description: Group trip ledgers with creator lock, optional co-hosts, ownership transfer, and QR join access.

/trips/{tripId}/bills/{billId}.description: Itemized bills for a trip; creator and co-host writes while active, member read-only.

/trips/{tripId}/receipts/{billId}.description: Compressed receipt images linked 1:1 with trip bills.

/trips/{tripId}/settlements/{settlementI.description: Recorded settlement payments between trip members.

/trips/{tripId}/syncedUsers/{userId}.description: Signed-in users synced to this trip for co-host management and ownership transfer.

/users/{userId}/tripLinks/{tripId}.description: Per-user mapping from signed-in account to participant ID in a trip.
